problem.statement: Persistent Kernel and Tile Scheduling -- Pattern: GROUP_SIZE_M Swizzle to Improve L2 Hit Rate

payload.technique: Pattern: GROUP_SIZE_M Swizzle to Improve L2 Hit Rate

implementation.snippet:
```python
# Standard tile indexing (row-major) — low L2 hit rate
pid_m = pid // num_pid_n
pid_n = pid % num_pid_n

# Swizzle tile indexing — adjacent CTAs share input rows/columns
num_pid_in_group = GROUP_SIZE_M * num_pid_n
group_id = pid // num_pid_in_group
first_pid_m = group_id * GROUP_SIZE_M
group_size_m = min(num_pid_m - first_pid_m, GROUP_SIZE_M)
pid_m = first_pid_m + ((pid % num_pid_in_group) % group_size_m)
pid_n = (pid % num_pid_in_group) // group_size_m
```
